source: Revised incentive representation (2025-26 scheme rules, applied to the 2021 cost basis). Supersedes incentives.json, which is retained unchanged for provenance. BUS: GOV.UK, Apply for the Boiler Upgrade Scheme (check if you're eligible; what you can get): GBP 7,500 per air-source heat pump, GBP 1,500 extra for oil/LPG homes until March 2027, social housing not eligible. Low-income fabric grant: ECO4 (closing December 2026) and its successor Warm Homes: Local Grant (EPC D-G, low income); per-household limit GBP 10,000 after De Mel et al. (2023) Energy 268, 126651, Table 7. Social housing grant: Warm Homes: Social Housing Fund Wave 3 (GBP 7,500 per home, landlord co-funding about 50%, EPC D-G). GBIS: Great British Insulation Scheme (EPC D-G; closed 31 March 2026, retained for the study period).
epc_imputation: dwellings without a certificate take the median SAP of certified dwellings with the same construction_sa x age_band_resolved; fallback construction_sa, then all certified dwellings

BUS.kind: fixed, limited to the heat-pump cost
BUS.rule: ASHP installed in a dwelling that is not social rented; grant = min(amount + off-gas extra, ASHP cost)

low_income_fabric.rule: not social rented, EPC D-G, and LSOA fuel poverty >= 12% or IMD decile <= 3

GBIS.rule: not social rented, EPC D-G, floor area < 120 m2, and not eligible for the low-income fabric grant
